Our promise to you

Sit in our chair with confidence

Choosing a new salon is a big step. Here is what you can expect every time you visit Levy's.

  • We listen first

    Every visit starts with a chat about your hair and the look you want. Bring a photo if you have one.

  • Price agreed upfront

    We confirm the price before we start, so there are no surprises when you pay.

  • Healthy hair comes first

    Before any relaxer, S-Curl or colour, we check your scalp and hair so the treatment is right for you.

  • You leave happy

    Not quite right? Tell us before you leave and we'll adjust it there and then.
